evidence.title: EXCLUSIVE: Switzerland's Aeon acquires Aware Health as total Seed funding surpasses €12 million | EU-Startups

name: EXCLUSIVE: Switzerland's Aeon acquires Aware Health as Seed funding passes €12M
summary: EU-Startups article: Zurich-based Aeon acquires German blood diagnostics platform Aware Health, taking its Seed funding past €12 million.
description: News article on EU-Startups about preventive healthcare company Aeon (Zurich) acquiring the German blood diagnostics platform Aware Health. The Seed extension, co-led by Araya Ventures, brings Aeon's total Seed funding to over €12 million; the article covers the deal, Aeon's AI-powered whole-body check-ups combining MRI with recurring blood diagnostics, and comparable 2026 European preventive-health rounds.
contains: Seed extension co-led by Araya Ventures
Aeon total Seed funding over €12 million
Aware Health: 100+ biomarkers, 45+ blood-draw locations, close to 10,000 active customers
